notes: YOU NOW RECLAIM THE WHOLE 20% ON PURCHASES. Ghana's Value Added Tax Act, 2025 (Act 1151) took effect on 1 January 2026 and made the NHIL (2.5%) and the GETFund levy (2.5%) reclaimable input tax. They were not before — only the 15% VAT proper came back, and the two levies were part of what you paid for the goods. If you are VAT-registered, bills dated from 1 January 2026 now reclaim the full charge automatically. You do not need to change any setting. YOUR OLDER BILLS ARE UNTOUCHED. Anything dated before 1 January 2026 keeps exactly the treatment it was entered under. The app decides which rule applies from the DATE ON THE BILL, not from a setting — so entering a 2025 invoice today still reclaims the 2025 share, and nothing already in your books has been restated. THE VAT RETURN STILL SHOWS VAT, NHIL AND GETFUND SEPARATELY, as the GRA's form requires, even though the three are now one reclaimable charge. If you are not VAT-registered, nothing about this release changes your books. NO DATA RESHAPE: installs straight over the previous version. Please still take a backup first — Backup & Export, Back up now.
